## Commands

### `efficiency`

Report instruction-context efficiency.

```text
agent-context-lint efficiency [repository] [--agent <profile>] [--format terminal|json] [--compare <repository>] [--no-color] [--width <columns>]
```

Implementation owner: `G09`. Operand count: 0–1.

Options:

- `-h, --help` — Show command help.
- `--agent <profile>` — Select an exact client profile. Values: claude-code, codex-cli, copilot-cli,
  copilot-cloud-agent, copilot-code-review, copilot-vscode, cursor-agent, gemini-cli.
- `--format <format>` — Select deterministic terminal or JSON output. Values: terminal, json.
- `--compare <repository>` — Compare against an independently resolved repository source.
- `--no-color` — Render terminal output without ANSI color.
- `--width <columns>` — Set terminal width from 40 through 240 columns.

### `scan`

Lint repository agent instruction files.

```text
agent-context-lint scan [repository] [--format stylish|json|sarif] [--rule ACLNNN] [--severity <override>] [--fail-on error|warning|never] [--maximum-concurrency 1..10] [--profile profile] [--surface surface] [--changed --base ref] [--fix-dry-run]
```

Implementation owner: `I02`. Operand count: 0–1.

Options:

- `-h, --help` — Show command help.
- `--format <format>` — Select stylish, JSON, or SARIF output. Values: stylish, json, sarif.
- `--rule <rule>` — Run only a registered rule; repeat to select more.
- `--severity <override>` — Override one rule severity as ACLNNN=severity; repeatable.
- `--fail-on <threshold>` — Choose the diagnostic failure threshold. Values: error, warning, never.
- `--maximum-concurrency <workers>` — Bound rule-family worker concurrency from 1 through 10.
- `--profile <profile>` — Select a client profile; repeat to select more. Values: claude-code,
  codex-cli, copilot-cli, copilot-cloud-agent, copilot-code-review, copilot-vscode, cursor-agent,
  gemini-cli.
- `--surface <surface>` — Select a client surface; repeat to select more. Values:
  claude-code/local-session, codex-cli/local-cli-single-cwd, copilot-cli/local-terminal,
  copilot-cloud-agent/github-hosted, copilot-code-review/github-hosted, copilot-vscode/local-chat,
  cursor-agent/cli, cursor-agent/ide, gemini-cli/local-terminal.
- `--changed` — Select diagnostics changed from one explicit Git base reference.
- `--base <ref>` — Resolve the exact Git base reference for --changed mode.
- `--fix-dry-run` — Preview selected mechanical fixes without writing.

### `standards`

Inspect, verify, or update standards knowledge.

agent-context-lint standards <status|check|update> [--format terminal|json] [--dry-run] [--cache <directory>]

## Output and platform policy

Generated reference, completion, and manual artifacts contain UTF-8 text with LF line endings, no
ANSI styling, timestamps, host paths, or terminal-width assumptions. Manual-page wrapping belongs to
the selected pager. Native completion artifacts support Bash, Zsh, and Fish on their supported
Unix-like hosts; Windows users can use the Bash artifact under WSL or Git Bash. Native PowerShell
completion is outside the v1 contract and is reported as unsupported rather than emulated.
